# Claude — Auto-Memory Mirror

**Purpose:** auditability mirror of Claude's autogenerated memory index, per the
author's standing instruction that every AI agent mirror its memory files to a
`<AI-Agent>-MEMORY.md` in the repo root.

**Agent:** Claude (Anthropic). **Mirrored:** 2026-08-09.
**Source of truth:** `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/` — this file is a
copy of that directory's `MEMORY.md` index and is regenerated, not hand-edited.
Each entry links a memory file in that directory, not a file in this repo.

Landing-gear session detail lives in
[`airframe/landing-gear/HANDOFF.md`](airframe/landing-gear/HANDOFF.md).
